patch_description: This redesign separates placement construction, state scoring, and local repair into modular helpers. It uses multiple deterministic greedy starting layouts, selects the best initial KVPR distribution, then performs lexicographically improving local search with direct moves, swaps, and bounded ejection chains. Ejection chains move a blocking destination model to a third low-pressure GPU before relocating a bottleneck model, improving memory-fragmentation handling while preserving feasible GPU memory usage.
